smolder.brief: Smolder, a small-batch hot sauce brand from Bristol. Three sauces smoked over oak. A landing page that sells bottles online.

components.looks: photo of the three bottles on a charred oak board, 4px corners
components.content: First Light, Slow Burn and Last Word

copy.headline: Smoked over oak in Bristol
copy.body: Three hot sauces. We smoke the peppers for twelve hours before they go in the bottle.

sections.purpose: Let people pick a sauce by flavour and heat

components.looks: rows separated by #e4e4e4 hairlines, Source Sans 3 18px
components.content: First Light, jalapeno and lime, heat 3, £8 / Slow Burn, chipotle and ancho, heat 6, £9 / Last Word, scotch bonnet and plum, heat 9, £9

sections.purpose: Explain the smoking so the price makes sense

components.looks: photo of the oak smoker at dawn, 4px corners

copy.headline: Twelve hours over oak
copy.body: The peppers sit over oak offcuts from a Devon cooperage overnight. Then we blend, bottle and label every batch by hand, sixty bottles at a time.

sections.purpose: Answer the questions people have before they order

components.content: Postage: £3.50, free over £30 / Dispatch: Tuesdays and Fridays / Storage: keeps a year unopened
Smolder Sauce Co, Unit 4, St Philips, Bristol. hello@smolder.co.uk

tidewater.brief: Tidewater, a surf school in Polzeath, Cornwall. Beginners and families book lessons by the tide and hire boards and wetsuits.

sections.layout: photo of the beach across the full width, headline and button on top of it at the bottom left

components.looks: photo of Polzeath beach at low tide

copy.headline: Learn to surf in Polzeath
copy.body: Lessons start two hours either side of low tide, when the waves are small.

components.content: Family lesson, 2 hours, £45 per person / Beginner group, 2 hours, £40 / Private lesson, 1 hour, £70
